name: Axe Compute Inc. Common Stock
description: Axe Compute Inc functions as an active infrastructure operator. The company intends to expand access to AI compute resources by utilizing the Aethir network, which provides scalable, cost-efficient cloud GPU services for AI, machine learning, gaming, and rendering applications. Through the use of Aethir's decentralized international infrastructure, the company aims to provide access to bare-metal GPUs at scale for both emerging and established organizations.
